title: counting bars
system_instruction_addendum: COUNTING BARS ADDENDUM: Count one-two-three-four across four bars (sixteen beats). The user taps on the one each bar. Do not narrate microtiming.

tutor_speak.text: a bar is four beats — count one, two, three, four.
four bars in a row is a phrase — the unit most tracks build on.
listen to the next four bars and tap continue on the one that opens bar five.

hints.text: the one of each bar is the heaviest kick — that is your anchor.
count out loud — one two three four, one two three four.
